commission_pricing_adjustments_value_che.name: commission_pricing_adjustments_value_check
commission_pricing_adjustments_value_che.value:
(
          "commission_pricing_adjustments"."calculation_type" = 'fixed'
          AND "commission_pricing_adjustments"."fixed_amount" IS NOT NULL
          AND "commission_pricing_adjustments"."fixed_amount" >= 0
          AND "commission_pricing_adjustments"."percentage_rate" IS NULL
          AND "commission_pricing_adjustments"."calculation_basis" = 'none'
        )
        OR
        (
          "commission_pricing_adjustments"."calculation_type" = 'percentage'
          AND "commission_pricing_adjustments"."fixed_amount" IS NULL
          AND "commission_pricing_adjustments"."percentage_rate" IS NOT NULL
          AND "commission_pricing_adjustments"."percentage_rate" >= 0
          AND "commission_pricing_adjustments"."percentage_rate" <= 100
          AND "commission_pricing_adjustments"."calculation_basis" != 'none'
        )

commission_pricing_adjustments_availabil.name: commission_pricing_adjustments_availability_check
commission_pricing_adjustments_availabil.value:
"commission_pricing_adjustments"."available_until" IS NULL
        OR "commission_pricing_adjustments"."available_from" IS NULL
        OR "commission_pricing_adjustments"."available_until" > "commission_pricing_adjustments"."available_from"

commission_pricing_options_availability_.name: commission_pricing_options_availability_check
commission_pricing_options_availability_.value:
"commission_pricing_options"."available_until" IS NULL
        OR "commission_pricing_options"."available_from" IS NULL
        OR "commission_pricing_options"."available_until" > "commission_pricing_options"."available_from"

commission_pricing_services_availability.name: commission_pricing_services_availability_check
commission_pricing_services_availability.value:
"commission_pricing_services"."available_until" IS NULL
        OR "commission_pricing_services"."available_from" IS NULL
        OR "commission_pricing_services"."available_until" > "commission_pricing_services"."available_from"

commission_pricing_versions_effective_wi.name: commission_pricing_versions_effective_window_check
commission_pricing_versions_effective_wi.value:
"commission_pricing_versions"."effective_until" IS NULL
        OR "commission_pricing_versions"."effective_from" IS NULL
        OR "commission_pricing_versions"."effective_until" > "commission_pricing_versions"."effective_from"

commission_pricing_versions_publication_.name: commission_pricing_versions_publication_check
commission_pricing_versions_publication_.value:
(
          "commission_pricing_versions"."status" = 'draft'
          AND "commission_pricing_versions"."published_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "commission_pricing_versions"."status" IN ('active', 'archived')
          AND "commission_pricing_versions"."published_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "commission_pricing_versions"."effective_from" IS NOT NULL
        )

commission_agreements_acceptance_check.name: commission_agreements_acceptance_check
commission_agreements_acceptance_check.value:
"commission_agreements"."status" != 'accepted'
          OR (
            "commission_agreements"."accepted_by_name" IS NOT NULL
            AND "commission_agreements"."accepted_by_email" IS NOT NULL
            AND "commission_agreements"."acceptance_method" IS NOT NULL
            AND "commission_agreements"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL
          )

commission_documents_generated_file_chec.name: commission_documents_generated_file_check
commission_documents_generated_file_chec.value:
"commission_documents"."status" = 'draft'
          OR (
            "commission_documents"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL
            AND "commission_documents"."content_sha256" IS NOT NULL
            AND "commission_documents"."generated_at" IS NOT NULL
          )

commission_quotes_status_dates_check.name: commission_quotes_status_dates_check
commission_quotes_status_dates_check.value:
(
            "commission_quotes"."status" = 'draft'
            AND "commission_quotes"."sent_at" IS NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."accepted_at" IS NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."declined_at" IS NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."expired_at" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "commission_quotes"."status" = 'sent'
            AND "commission_quotes"."valid_until" IS NOT NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."accepted_at" IS NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."declined_at" IS NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."expired_at" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "commission_quotes"."status" = 'accepted'
            AND "commission_quotes"."valid_until" IS NOT NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."declined_at" IS NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."expired_at" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "commission_quotes"."status" = 'declined'
            AND "commission_quotes"."valid_until" IS NOT NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."accepted_at" IS NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."declined_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."expired_at" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "commission_quotes"."status" = 'expired'
            AND "commission_quotes"."valid_until" IS NOT NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."accepted_at" IS NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."declined_at" IS NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."expired_at" IS NOT NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "commission_quotes"."status" = 'superseded'
            AND "commission_quotes"."valid_until" IS NOT NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."accepted_at" IS NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."declined_at" IS NULL
            AND "commission_quotes"."expired_at" IS NULL
          )

commission_tax_documents_file_hash_check.name: commission_tax_documents_file_hash_check
commission_tax_documents_file_hash_check.value:
"commission_tax_documents"."storage_key" IS NULL
          OR "commission_tax_documents"."content_sha256" IS NOT NULL

commissions_hold_state_check.name: commissions_hold_state_check
commissions_hold_state_check.value:
(
          "commissions"."is_on_hold" = true
          AND "commissions"."hold_started_at" IS NOT NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "commissions"."is_on_hold" = false
          AND "commissions"."hold_started_at" IS NULL
        )
